You see an alchemy still.
How to use: Press C beside it, pick reagents from your pack with the pick rows (the menu shows the mix and what it would make), then choose brew the mix, or brew a full batch. Distil 4 brine with 5 fuel into a separate empty flask. Choose 2 water or 1 water and a pound of brine crust at your feet. With a flask of bog-mire in your pack, press C beside it and choose settle (to clean water or to oil), or bake to boil mire down to fire clay.
Needs: to brew: reagents in your pack that make something together; to keep brine crust: a clear, dry cell beside the still; to settle: a flask with at least 4 units of bog-mire, and either a burning fire within 2 cells that can spare 5 fuel a flask or a steam vent or ash bed within 2 cells; to bake clay: a flask with at least 8 units, and a burning fire within 2 cells that can spare 10 fuel (a vent is not hot enough).
Cost and limits: Brewing uses up the picked reagents. Settling gives 1 water or oil for every 4 mire. The dregs stay in the pot. Baking spends 8 mire for 1 fire clay and leaves any extra mire in the flask.
Right now you cannot: brew the mix (Pick the reagents to brew from your pack first), distill brine into water (Carry a separate empty single flask that holds 2 water), keep brine crust (Carry a separate empty single flask that holds 1 water), settle 12 mire (Settling needs a lit fire beside the still) and 1 more.

A receiving vessel sits below a coiled condenser. The still separates a mixture one patient drop at a time.

source: Native GameBootstrap in Editor Play with normal keys and isolated saves
notes: Prior retained ordinary seed-65 acquired flask, torch and brine. No supplies were inserted or position forced.
Peat Works was generated on entry. Ordinary combat included a level-up and subsequent damage. Sill branches start at the same 23 HP worksite.
Use of the fixed still tested here. Native tests cover a deployed camp still next to a vent, hidden-source privacy, low fuel, and finite countercases.
Each paid still action advanced 10 ticks and the loose torch also spent about 0.3 ambient fuel.
Cold Examine and paid Examine were opened through the actual interaction menu. Screenshots are native Game views.
